description: Update an existing assignment group in a course and return the updated Canvas assignment group object. Only the fields passed are changed — anything omitted keeps its current value, so repeating the same call leaves the group in the same state, unlike `create_assignment_group`, which always makes a new group. Use it to repair a weighted gradebook: `group_weight` sets the group's percent of the final grade (which changes nothing unless the course is set to weight its final grade by assignment group — a course setting `update_course` can turn on), and `rules` drops the lowest or highest scores in the group, with never_drop exempting specific assignments. Canvas rejects a drop rule larger than the number of active assignments in the group, and refuses a `group_weight` or `rules` change with an authorization error — not a validation error — when any assignment in the group falls inside a closed grading period, unless the caller is an account admin. Read `list_assignment_groups` for the current values and the group ID first. Requires permission to manage assignments in the course.

assignment_group_id.description: The Canvas assignment group ID to update

group_weight.description: The group's percent of the total grade (e.g. 40 for 40%)

position.description: New 1-based position relative to the other assignment groups

rules.description: Drop rules for the group; replaces the existing rules wholesale

drop_highest.description: Number of highest scores in this group to drop

drop_lowest.description: Number of lowest scores in this group to drop

never_drop.description: Assignment IDs that the drop rules must never discard

sis_source_id.description: The SIS source ID for the group

name: update_assignment_group
title: Update Assignment Group
